options.name: api_version
options.description: The version of the Docker API running on the Docker Host. Defaults to the latest version of the API supported by Docker SDK for Python and the docker daemon. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_API_VERSION) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: args
options.description: List arguments to be passed to the container. Corresponds to the C(ARG) parameter of C(docker service create).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Use a CA certificate when performing server verification by providing the path to a CA certificate file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(ca.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used. This option was called O(ca_cert) and got renamed to O(ca_path) in community.docker 3.6.0. The old name has been added as an alias and can still be used.

options.name: cap_add
options.description: List of capabilities to add to the container. Requires API version >= 1.41.

options.name: cap_drop
options.description: List of capabilities to drop from the container. Requires API version >= 1.41.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Path to the client's TLS certificate file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(cert.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Path to the client's TLS key file. If the value is not specified in the task and the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) is set, the file C(key.pem) from the directory specified in the environment variable E(DOCKER_CERT_PATH) will be used.

options.name: command
options.description: Command to execute when the container starts. A command may be either a string or a list or a list of strings. Corresponds to the C(COMMAND) parameter of C(docker service create).

options.name: configs
options.description: List of dictionaries describing the service configs. Corresponds to the C(--config) option of C(docker service create). Requires API version >= 1.30.

options.name: container_labels
options.description: Dictionary of key value pairs. Corresponds to the C(--container-label) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: debug
options.description: Debug mode.

options.name: dns
options.description: List of custom DNS servers. Corresponds to the C(--dns) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: dns_options
options.description: List of custom DNS options. Corresponds to the C(--dns-option) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: dns_search
options.description: List of custom DNS search domains. Corresponds to the C(--dns-search) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: docker_host
options.description: The URL or Unix socket path used to connect to the Docker API. To connect to a remote host, provide the TCP connection string. For example, V(tcp://192.0.2.23:2376). If TLS is used to encrypt the connection, the module will automatically replace C(tcp) in the connection URL with C(https). If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_HOST) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: endpoint_mode
options.description: Service endpoint mode. Corresponds to the C(--endpoint-mode) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: env
options.description: List or dictionary of the service environment variables. If passed a list each items need to be in the format of C(KEY=VALUE). If passed a dictionary values which might be parsed as numbers, booleans or other types by the YAML parser must be quoted (for example V("true")) in order to avoid data loss. Corresponds to the C(--env) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: env_files
options.description: List of paths to files, present on the target, containing environment variables C(FOO=BAR). The order of the list is significant in determining the value assigned to a variable that shows up more than once. If variable also present in O(env), then O(env) value will override.

options.name: force_update
options.description: Force update even if no changes require it. Corresponds to the C(--force) option of C(docker service update).

options.name: groups
options.description: List of additional group names and/or IDs that the container process will run as. Corresponds to the C(--group) option of C(docker service update).

options.name: healthcheck
options.description: Configure a check that is run to determine whether or not containers for this service are "healthy". See the docs for the L(HEALTHCHECK Dockerfile instruction,https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/builder/#healthcheck) for details on how healthchecks work. O(healthcheck.interval), O(healthcheck.timeout), and O(healthcheck.start_period) are specified as durations. They accept duration as a string in a format that look like: V(5h34m56s), V(1m30s), and so on. The supported units are V(us), V(ms)

options.name: hostname
options.description: Container hostname. Corresponds to the C(--hostname) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: hosts
options.description: Dict of host-to-IP mappings, where each host name is a key in the dictionary. Each host name will be added to the container's /etc/hosts file. Corresponds to the C(--host) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: image
options.description: Service image path and tag. Corresponds to the C(IMAGE) parameter of C(docker service create).

options.name: init
options.description: Use an init inside each service container to forward signals and reap processes. Corresponds to the C(--init) option of C(docker service create). Requires API version >= 1.37.

options.name: labels
options.description: Dictionary of key value pairs. Corresponds to the C(--label) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: limits
options.description: Configures service resource limits.

options.name: logging
options.description: Logging configuration for the service.

options.name: mode
options.description: Service replication mode. Service will be removed and recreated when changed. Corresponds to the C(--mode) option of C(docker service create). The value V(replicated-job) was added in community.docker 4.7.0, and requires API version >= 1.41 and Docker SDK for Python >= 6.0.0.

options.name: mounts
options.description: List of dictionaries describing the service mounts. Corresponds to the C(--mount) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: name
options.description: Service name. Corresponds to the C(--name) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: networks
options.description: List of the service networks names or dictionaries. When passed dictionaries valid sub-options are C(name), which is required, and C(aliases) and C(options). Prior to API version 1.29, updating and removing networks is not supported. If changes are made the service will then be removed and recreated. Corresponds to the C(--network) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: placement
options.description: Configures service placement preferences and constraints.

options.name: publish
options.description: List of dictionaries describing the service published ports. Corresponds to the C(--publish) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: read_only
options.description: Mount the containers root filesystem as read only. Corresponds to the C(--read-only) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: replicas
options.description: Number of containers instantiated in the service. Valid only if O(mode=replicated) or O(mode=replicated-job). If set to V(-1), and service is not present, service replicas will be set to V(1). If set to V(-1), and service is present, service replicas will be unchanged. Corresponds to the C(--replicas) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: reservations
options.description: Configures service resource reservations.

options.name: resolve_image
options.description: If the current image digest should be resolved from registry and updated if changed. Requires API version >= 1.30.

options.name: restart_config
options.description: Configures if and how to restart containers when they exit.

options.name: rollback_config
options.description: Configures how the service should be rolled back in case of a failing update.

options.name: secrets
options.description: List of dictionaries describing the service secrets. Corresponds to the C(--secret) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: state
options.description: V(absent) - A service matching the specified name will be removed and have its tasks stopped. V(present) - Asserts the existence of a service matching the name and provided configuration parameters. Unspecified configuration parameters will be set to docker defaults.

options.name: stop_grace_period
options.description: Time to wait before force killing a container. Accepts a duration as a string in a format that look like: V(5h34m56s), V(1m30s), and so on. The supported units are V(us), V(ms), V(s), V(m) and V(h). Corresponds to the C(--stop-grace-period) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: stop_signal
options.description: Override default signal used to stop the container. Corresponds to the C(--stop-signal) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: sysctls
options.description: Dictionary of key, value pairs.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds to wait on a response from the API. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TIMEOUT) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: tls
options.description: Secure the connection to the API by using TLS without verifying the authenticity of the Docker host server. Note that if O(validate_certs) is set to V(true) as well, it will take precedence. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: tls_hostname
options.description: When verifying the authenticity of the Docker Host server, provide the expected name of the server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS_HOSTNAME) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used. Note that this option had a default value V(localhost) in older versions. It was removed in community.docker 3.0.0. B(Note:) this option is no longer supported for Docker SDK for Python 7.0.0+. Specifying i

options.name: tty
options.description: Allocate a pseudo-TTY. Corresponds to the C(--tty) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: update_config
options.description: Configures how the service should be updated. Useful for configuring rolling updates.

options.name: use_ssh_client
options.description: For SSH transports, use the C(ssh) CLI tool instead of paramiko. Requires Docker SDK for Python 4.4.0 or newer.

options.name: user
options.description: Sets the username or UID used for the specified command. Before Ansible 2.8, the default value for this option was V(root). The default has been removed so that the user defined in the image is used if no user is specified here. Corresponds to the C(--user) option of C(docker service create).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Secure the connection to the API by using TLS and verifying the authenticity of the Docker host server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY) will be used instead. If the environment variable is not set, the default value will be used.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Path to the working directory. Corresponds to the C(--workdir) option of C(docker service create).
